hypothesis: Image-local signed-distance Betti curves may encode neck closure and hole/component survival beyond raw counts or granulometry. Hardness improvement unproven.
reference_access: Wang2020 abstract and Moon2019 abstract/methods read via public publisher pages. Own 2D discrete Betti curves, NOT persistent homology, persistence diagrams/images, or paper performance reproduction. No external training data/code.
definition: Raw grayscale image quantiles20/50/80; <= retains ties. SEDT=EDT(mask)-EDT(complement), nearest opposite pixel inside image. Allone +inf/allzero -inf explicitly. Excursion SEDT>=d at -16,-8,-4,-2,-1,0,1,2,4,8,16 pixels. Finite rectangle/no wrap; topological outside is background. Foreground4/background8 or foreground8/background4, beta0=components and beta1=beta0-Euler. Edge-connected background never a hole. Each count divided by original image area65536. 3*11*2*2=132.
boundary_limit: Observed-image topology; structures truncated by edges remain censored. Distance does not invent opposite phase outside. d0 and d1 may duplicate because signed pixel distances have magnitude>=1.
preprocessing: Raw images no denoise; all X scaler and targetmean/std fit inside each innertrain/outertrain. No residual correction.
regression: Ridge alpha12/120/1200, innerGroupKFold3shuffle seed20261223+fold; inner pooled standalone RMSE selects alpha. Primary=.9*samefold007+.1*Betti132.
diagnostic: Zero-distance12 counts use same innerRidge grid; standalone and fixed.1 blend only diagnostic, not eligible alternatewinner. No feature/weight tuning.
screen: Original gain>conditionalpairedbootstrapSD AND >=3/5 positive folds. Compute allocation only, not significance. Only then both existing repartitions, unchanged design.
diagnostic_plan: Feature constants/duplicates; betti curves vs zero counts using foldtrain Ridge reconstruction (alpha120 fixed); image highfrequencyRMS association descriptive only (contains edges,not noise estimate); outertrain feature range and prediction range extrapolation diagnostics. No new features chosen. Granulometry differs: retained intensity/area vs topology; fixture checks equal raw counts but differing erosion connectivity.
scope: development400 only; no holdout/test data, candidateCSV/upload, installs/cost. Best007 protected.
bias: Development-only split robustness, not independent validation. All 400 rows informed historical feature/model/recipe choices. Kernel inner CV controls only current bandwidth/alpha choices. Exact/D4 groups do not verify source family independence. Conditional bootstrap omits fitting/selection uncertainty; the two partitions reuse the same observations. No holdout evaluation.
